the copper deposition and boric acid protection method can improve wettability of carbon fibers and aluminum matrix and restrain excessive chemical reaction between carbon fibers and aluminum.

the copper was deposited on the carbon fibers to enhance the interfacial wettability of carbon fiber and aluminum matrix and the excessive chemical reaction between carbon fibers and aluminum matrix was restrained.

copper deposition on carbon fibers improved the wettability between carbon fibers and aluminum and the interface between carbon fibers and copper is a mixed interface of carbon/copper and carbon/aluminum.

the interface of the C/Al composite.
the preparation of carbon fibers reinforced aluminum composite materials with the copper coating on carbon fiber and boric acid as a protective agent.
the preparation of carbon fibers reinforced aluminum composite by stir casting method, and the interface of composite was analyzed.

the interface of the C/Cu/Al composite was a mixed interface composed of C/Cu, C/Al and Al2Cu.

copper was deposited on short carbon fibers to improve wettability between short carbon fibers and aluminum matrix and boric acid was used in order to protect copper from being oxidized during the compounding process.
the interface of C/Al composite could be improved by using the method of depositing copper on carbon fibers.
